name: Opening Range Breakout
description: Buy the first 5-minute close above the 15-minute opening range, above VWAP, on elevated relative volume, in names trading above their 20-day EMA. Stop under the range (or 1.5 ATR, whichever is tighter). Take half at +1R, move stop to breakeven, trail the rest by 1.5 ATR off the high, hard target +3R, flat by 15:50 ET.
